body:
## Summary

Re-running `aitools install` on Windows corrupted the PowerShell profile. The installer's Step 7 runs `setup-user-shell.ps1`; plain `aitools` and `hh` do not. `setup-user-shell.ps1` refreshed its managed block with `[regex]::Replace($content, $pattern, ($block + "`n"))`. In a .NET replacement string `$_` means the whole input, and the block contains `$__aitoolsLocalBin` four times, so each one became a copy of the whole profile followed by `_aitoolsLocalBin`.

- The first run appends the block and is clean. Every refresh after that multiplies the profile (5 blocks, then 84, then 21,568) and leaves it unparseable, so none of it loads: `ParserError ... Missing closing ')' in expression`.
- The step still reported `OK managed block refreshed`, because the post-write check only looks for the two markers.
- On the commander's machine the 2026-06-22 run broke the profile (694 → 2,664 bytes) and today's run grew it to 41,783 bytes (84 blocks, 135 parse errors). The next run would have written about 15 MB.

`setup-user-shell.sh` is not affected: Perl's `s///` does not re-expand `$` inside the interpolated block.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `scripts/setup-user-shell.ps1` | Block inserted with a `MatchEvaluator` (literal), the idiom `setup-user-claude.ps1` already uses |
| `scripts/setup-user-shell.ps1` | Spliced profile parse-checked before the write; a result with more parse errors than the current profile is not written (ERROR `managed block splice failed parse check`, exit 1). "UNTESTED on Windows" header line removed |
| `tests/setup-user-shell/test-setup-user-shell.ps1` (new) | Block added; refresh byte-identical over three runs; user lines around a stale block kept; a splice that would break the profile refused and the profile left unchanged |
| `.github/workflows/check.yml` | The new suite runs in the Windows job (native pwsh) |
| `registries/incidents.json` | Incident #172 filed and closed (v0.76.1), with root cause. Incident #173 filed (open, medium, not fixed here). Step 7 of `aitools-install.ps1` rewrites the shell-integration block on every run, with no backup, and leaves the blank line above it each time (the profile had 163 by June). Its removal loop also deletes any user lines placed directly after the block. The bash Step 7 leaves an existing block alone |
| `RELEASE_NOTES.md` | v0.76.1 |

## Verification (Windows 11, pwsh 7.6.10)

- `tests/setup-user-shell`: 10 passed, 0 failed. Against `origin/main`'s script: 4 passed, 6 failed.
- Scratch-profile smoke with an isolated USERPROFILE, log dir and summary file. Three inputs (no profile, a copy of the commander's 2026-06-22 profile, user lines around a stale block), three runs each:
  - Before the fix, 8 of 9 runs corrupted the profile and all 9 reported OK.
  - After the fix, all 9 runs pass and the profile is byte-identical from run 2 on.
- The old splice re-inserted into a temp copy of the fixed script: exit 1, ERROR row, profile unchanged.
- `check-pre-commit.ps1`: one FAIL, step 20 (dead path references), in files this PR does not touch:
  - `CLAUDE.md:100` names `.claude/rules/relay-outbound.md`, which is not on `origin/main`.
  - `.claude/settings.local.json` is untracked: it exists in the main checkout but not in a fresh worktree.
- `check-pre-push.ps1`: one FAIL, step 7. The dotprofile `deploy/` is stale for 47 generated files, most of which this PR does not touch (`setup-go.*`, `deploy-harness.payload`, `setup-user-shell.sh`, …). The step reports stale files only and does not commit anything. Rebuilding the real dotprofile is the commander's step.

## After merge

- On Windows machines where `aitools install` ran more than once since v0.70.0, `$PROFILE` is already broken, and this fix does not repair it. Restore the newest `Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1.bak.<UTC>` beside `$PROFILE` that parses. On the commander's machine this is done: it was restored from `.bak.2026-06-22T221110Z`.
- Until this merges, `aitools install` on Windows corrupts the profile again. Plain `aitools` and `hh` are safe.
- Rebuild the dotprofile `deploy/` (`build-deploy.sh`) so MDM endpoints get the fixed script.

## Review after (D-DEL5)

- Splice: `[regex]::Replace($content, $pattern, ($block + "`n"))` → `[regex]::Replace($content, $pattern, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $block + "`n" })`
- New ERROR row `shell` / `managed block splice failed parse check`
- Incident #172 (closed). Severity would be critical: every Windows machine that ran `aitools install` twice since v0.70.0 has a broken profile.
- New CI step "setup-user-shell PowerShell profile block tests (PowerShell, native)"

What and why: surfacing duty (.claude/rules/incident-governance.md),
found while restoring the commander's $PROFILE for #172. Step 7 of
aitools-install.ps1 removes the '# aitools shell integration' marker
and every following non-blank line, then re-appends the block on every
run: the blank line above it stays (the profile had 163 by 2026-06-15),
there is no Backup-File, and user lines placed directly after the block
are deleted. The bash Step 7 leaves an existing block alone. Filed
open, medium; not fixed here.

Verification: incidents.json parses; max id 173, no duplicate ids.
Not reproduced in isolation (blank-line growth inferred from the
backups and the code; the deletion from the code only), as the entry
says.

Review after: incidents.json + open #173 (severity medium: cosmetic
growth plus a latent deletion of user lines that a same-run backup
still holds).

Step 7 and setup-user-shell.ps1): scripts/aitools.ps1 calls the
installer inside `if ($doInstall)` only, and the no-argument sync runs
eight deploy scripts, setup-user-shell not among them. RELEASE_NOTES
v0.76.1 (title, fix 1) and incident #173 (impact) said "aitools".

Verification: incidents.json parses; grep of the branch diff finds no
other "aitools run / twice" wording.

Review after (old -> new):
- RELEASE_NOTES v0.76.1 title: "Re-running aitools no longer corrupts"
  -> "Re-running aitools install no longer corrupts"
- RELEASE_NOTES fix 1: "Re-running `aitools` on Windows corrupted
  `$PROFILE`:" -> "Re-running `aitools install` on Windows corrupted
  `$PROFILE` (installer Step 7; plain `aitools` does not run
  `setup-user-shell`):"

  `aitools install` run"
